Types of QR code

  • Account details: Name, bank and account number as plain text, so a customer can scan, read and copy them.
  • WhatsApp: Scanning opens a chat with your number, optionally with a ready message.
  • Wi-Fi: A guest joins the network by scanning, without typing the password (some older phones cannot read it).
  • vCard: Scanning saves your name, number and email as a contact on the phone.
  • Link / text: A website, social page or any text.

How to make a QR code

  1. Choose the type of QR at the top.
  2. Fill in the details; the QR changes as you type.
  3. Change the colours and add a logo if you like.
  4. Download PNG or JPG, or print a poster.
  5. Scan it with your phone camera to check it before using it.

QR code FAQ

Will the QR code keep working forever?

Yes. It is a simple QR that contains only what you typed. It has no expiry and is not tied to our site.

Does my information or Wi-Fi password go anywhere?

No. The QR is made in your browser and we store nothing. But anyone who has the QR image can read what is in it, so share a password QR carefully.

Is this an official bank payment QR?

No. The “Account details” QR only shows what you typed. For an official payment QR, contact your bank.

Why does my QR not scan?

Scanning is harder if the colours are too similar, the logo is large or the text is very long. Keep the QR dark and the background light.
